extracted.name: Bagna Càuda (Italian Garlic-Anchovy Appetizer)
extracted.description: Bagna càuda is a rich blend of garlic and anchovies to make a delicious spread or dip. This family recipe includes sardines for a more intense flavor.
ingredient_lines: 4 (2 ounce) cans anchovy fillets packed in olive oil, drained
3 (4 ounce) cans sardines packed in olive oil, drained
instruction_lines: Place canola oil in a skillet and heat over medium heat. Stir in garlic; cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Add butter, anchovies, and sardines; cook and stir until well blended, 10 to 15 minutes. Serve warm.
